intent_en: Compare the relative shares of the USA, Russia, other holders, and disarmament from 1990 through 2015.
narration_support: Since the Soviet Union collapsed the number of bombs has been coming down... Nuclear disarmament has reduced the potential human cost of a nuclear war in a very real way
chart_support: Horizontal bar chart titled 'DISARMAMENT' showing the number of nuclear warheads (represented by colored bars) peaking around 1990 and decreasing through 2015
evidence_note: The narration explicitly links the decrease in bombs since the Soviet collapse to reduced human cost, while the chart visualizes this decrease in total warheads (colored bars) after the 1990 peak.
narrative_goal: To illustrate the trend of nuclear disarmament following the Cold War and explain how the reduction in nuclear arsenals lowers the potential human cost of nuclear conflict.
current_model_input: Compare the relative shares of the USA, Russia, other holders, and disarmament from 1990 through 2015.
